title: Europa Clipper is on its way to Jupiter
summary: NASA launched the Europa Clipper spacecraft on a Falcon Heavy rocket from Kennedy Space Center, beginning a cruise of several years to Jupiter and its moon Europa.
body:
NASA launched the Europa Clipper spacecraft on a Falcon Heavy rocket from Kennedy Space Center, beginning a cruise of several years to Jupiter and its moon Europa.

According to NASA the spacecraft should arrive at Jupiter in 2030, after which it will make repeated close passes of Europa to study its ice shell and the ocean beneath.
